name: Software Engineer
description: Designs and builds software applications.

roadmap.description: Master Data Structures, Algorithms, and a primary language like Python or Java.
Learn React/Next.js for frontend or Node.js/Go for backend development.
Study Distributed Systems, Cloud (AWS/Azure), and DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

name: Data Scientist
description: Analyzes and intercepts complex digital data.

roadmap.description: Deep dive into Linear Algebra, Calculus, and Probability Theory.
Implement Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and Pytorch on real-world datasets.

links.title: Fast.ai: Practical Deep Learning for Coders

roadmap.description: Learn Spark, Hadoop, and Model Deployment (MLOps).

name: Graphic Designer
description: Creates visual concepts to communicate ideas that inspire.

roadmap.description: Learn Color Theory, Typography, and Visual Hierarchy.
Become proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.
Create real-world design projects for a professional portfolio.

name: Registered Nurse
description: Provides medical care and educates patients.

roadmap.description: Complete Anatomy, Physiology, and Microbiology courses.
Attend an accredited nursing program (ADN or BSN).
Study for and pass the national licensure examination.

name: Sales Manager
description: Directs organizational sales teams.

roadmap.description: Master lead generation and initial sales prospecting techniques.
Manage B2B accounts and learn complex negotiation strategies.
Transition into mentoring and managing high-performing sales teams.

name: Accountant
description: Prepares and examines financial records.

roadmap.description: Learn Bookkeeping, GAAP standards, and Financial Statement prep.
Specialize in external audit procedures and local tax regulations.
Prepare for and complete the Uniform CPA Examination.
